subject: Supplier briefing: essential setup items for NovaMetrics account activation
messages:
From: Sara Bell <sara.bell@novametrics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding request — NovaMetrics account activation

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Were ready to move forward on vendor setup so we can get the first POs active for the pilot next month. To avoid delays can you send the standard \"what we need from you / what youll get from us\" checklist and let us know who the primary PO and AP contacts are on your side?

Attached is our W-9 for your records (NovaMetrics-W9.pdf). A couple of quick clarifications from us:
- Do you require bank details in a particular template?
- Will Redwood accept e-invoices (Peppol/PEPPOL) or only emailed PDF invoices?

Appreciate the guidance — happy to jump on a 15 minute call if thats easier.

Thanks,
Sara Bell
Procurement Operations
NovaMetrics, Inc.
Attachment: NovaMetrics-W9.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bell <sara.bell@novametrics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding request — NovaMetrics account activation

Hi Sara — great to meet earlier. Thanks for sending the W-9. I've attached our supplier onboarding checklist that lays out both sides' items and an estimated timeline (RDW-supplier-onboarding-checklist.xlsx). High level:

What we need from you (items to return)
- Completed onboarding checklist (attached) with primary billing contact, preferred remit method, and legal payee name
- W-9 or W-8 (received)
- Bank details (PDF or bank template) + ACH routing info for US payees
- Sample invoice (PDF) showing itemization and PO number placement
- If applicable: certificate of insurance (COI) and reseller exemption forms

What Redwood will provide / do
- Create supplier record in ERP and send a supplier ID within 1-2 business days after docs are received
- Create a vendor portal account and send portal invite (you can upload invoices there)
- Issue PO numbers after supplier activation; expected lead time 3-5 business days after verification
- Finance team will confirm payment terms and whether we can accept e-invoices (tagging finance@redwood.com)

Next steps for us: please return the completed checklist and bank details. If you want e-invoicing, well loop in Finance to confirm technical steps. Ive ccd Marcus (Finance) for visibility on payment formats.

Neha Kapoor
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: RDW-supplier-onboarding-checklist.xlsx
From: Sara Bell <sara.bell@novametrics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding request — NovaMetrics account activation

Thanks Neha — that checklist helps a lot. A few quick items from our side:
- Attached is our bank details PDF (NovaMetrics-bank-details.pdf).
- We can provide invoices via the portal or emailed PDFs; wed prefer e-invoicing if Redwood supports it.
- Is there a PO prefix we should expect on all POs (to include on invoices)?

Also, who should we name as the Redwood PO contact for operational questions? On our side the PO contact will be me (sara.bell@novametrics.com).

Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding request — NovaMetrics account activation

Sara — thanks, received the bank details and confirm we can accept emailed PDF invoices into the portal. Finance is evaluating electronic invoicing (Peppol); I created a ticket to track that work: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-2457 (cc Marcus).

Quick answers and next steps:
- PO prefix: youll see PO numbers with the RDW- prefix; please place the PO number in the invoice header and on line-level item descriptions where possible.
- PO contact: Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com) will be your operational contact for PO questions and remittance coordination.
- Portal: we will send the vendor portal invite within 24 hours. Once you accept, you can upload invoices directly and we will route to Finance for approval.
- Timeline: once the checklist + bank details are in the portal, supplier activation typically completes within 2 business days and a PO will be sent shortly after. If youd like us to expedite for the pilot, note that here and well request priority onboarding.

Ive attached a small PO template (PO-creation-template.csv) to show the fields Finance prefers on incoming invoices. Please upload the completed checklist and example invoice in the portal when you receive the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting NovaMetrics set up.

Neha Kapoor
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: PO-creation-template.csv
